$comment: Parser pipeline §6.2, Python table. Evaluated in order; the first rule whose construct matches a branch limb decides is_error_path. `construct` ids are recognised by src/language/branches.ts, which refuses to run if this file names one it does not know. Keep this a data file (handoff §2).

rules.note: `raise` anywhere in the limb body (not inside a nested def).

An `except` limb defaults to true even when it continues with further calls. Open question (parser §10): a handler that retries is arguably the happy path. Edges in such a limb carry confidence_reason saying so.
The limb ends in `return` while the enclosing function has statements after the branch.
